freeze_requirements: Root identifies final catalog/report pair after appearance 1.1 processing.
Catalog SHA equals assembly summary catalog_sha256; reused SQLite catalog_version must equal it.
Original benchmark remains byte-identical; unresolved scope questions are disclosed, not rewritten.
Use a fresh prefix-named output directory; retain historical diagnostic versions.
review_protocol: Nonempty top10 is candidate availability, not relevance acceptance.
Confirm eligible mouse pool is the requested primary whole-animal object; file scientific unknown remains non-match.
Final adopted families must come from an actual identified reviewer decision after seeing exact previews; no top-ranked/autodownload-as-adoption rule.
Label all example projects validation_exercise; do not claim real user research adoption.
Attach final reviewer adoption ledger with exact catalog SHA and evidence URI/SHA, then rerun behavior tool with --ledger <LEDGER_PATH>.
Merge exact catalog-bound real appearance cases separately; this script never pretends its empty appearance_cases passed.
